title: cynanchica rupicola
intro: Cynanchica rupicola, commonly known as the Himalayan Milk Vine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems, thanks to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchica rupicola include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents present in Cynanchica rupicola contribute to its potential therapeutic uses in traditional medicine and modern research, making it an interesting subject for further study.
